augments.descZh: 获得?攻击距离。

augments.name: Big Brain
augments.desc: Gain<shield> 3 Shield </shield>for every <scaleAP> 1 Ability Power</scaleAP>. Resets on death or 70 seconds after depletion.
augments.descZh: 每拥有<scaleAP>1法术强度</scaleAP>就会获得<shield>3护盾值</shield>。阵亡时或耗尽后70秒重置。

augments.name: Heavy Hitter
augments.desc: Your Attacks deal additional <physicalDamage>physical damage</physicalDamage> equal to 3.5% of your <scaleHealth>max Health. </scaleHealth>
augments.descZh: 你的攻击造成相当于你3.5%<scaleHealth>最大生命值</scaleHealth>的额外<physicalDamage>物理伤害</physicalDamage>。

augments.name: Flashbang
augments.desc: Your Flash causes an explosion that damages and <status>Slows</status> (resets on death).
augments.descZh: 你的【闪现】会引发一次爆炸，造成伤害和<status>减速</status>（阵亡时重置）。

augments.name: Fey Magic
augments.desc: Damaging with your <attention>Ultimate</attention> <status>Polymorphs</status> enemies for a few seconds.
augments.descZh: 你的<attention>终极技能</attention>的伤害会对敌人造成持续若干秒的<status>变形</status>效果。

augments.name: Giant Slayer
augments.desc: Become tiny, gain <speed>Movement Speed</speed>, and gain bonus damage to champions based on how much larger they are than you.
augments.descZh: 体型变小，获得<speed>移动速度</speed>，并基于敌方英雄体型大于你的程度获得额外伤害。

augments.name: Stackosaurus Rex
augments.desc: When you gain permanent <keywordMajor>Stacks</keywordMajor> of an Ability, gain 100% more!
augments.descZh: 在你获得一个技能的永久<keywordMajor>层数</keywordMajor>时，多获得100%！

augments.name: ADAPt
augments.desc: Convert <scaleAD>Bonus Attack Damage</scaleAD> to <scaleAP>Ability Power</scaleAP>. Gain <scaleAP>15% Ability Power</scaleAP>.
augments.descZh: 将<scaleAD>额外攻击力</scaleAD>转化为<scaleAP>法术强度</scaleAP>。获得<scaleAP>15%法术强度</scaleAP>。

augments.name: escAPADe
augments.desc: Convert <scaleAP>Ability Power</scaleAP> to <scaleAD>Bonus Attack Damage</scaleAD>. Gain <scaleAD>15% Attack Damage</scaleAD>.
augments.descZh: 将<scaleAP>法术强度</scaleAP>转化为<scaleAD>额外攻击力</scaleAD>。获得<scaleAD>15%攻击力</scaleAD>。

augments.name: It's Killing Time
augments.desc: After casting your Ultimate, mark all enemies and store up damage you deal to them. When it ends, detonate the damage.
augments.descZh: 在施放你的终极技能后，标记所有敌人并存储你对他们造成的伤害。当它结束时，引爆该伤害。

augments.name: Spin To Win
augments.desc: Your spin Abilities gain 30 Ability Haste and deal 30% more damage, increase to 50% for Ultimates
augments.descZh: 你的旋转类技能获得30技能急速并且造成30%额外伤害，对于终极技能，该额外伤害提升至50%。

augments.name: Fan The Hammer
augments.desc: Attacks against enemy champions fire 5 missiles that deal more damage with distance. Each direction has its own Cooldown.
augments.descZh: 对敌方英雄的攻击会发射5个飞弹，造成随距离提升的额外伤害。每个方向的冷却时间独立计算。

augments.name: Dual Wield
augments.desc: Attacks fire a bolt that applies <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> effects at reduced strength. Gain <attackSpeed>10% total Attack Speed</attackSpeed>.
augments.descZh: 在攻击时，发射一个箭矢，它施加效能削减的<OnHit>攻击特效</OnHit>。获得<attackSpeed>10%总攻击速度</attackSpeed>。

augments.name: Transmute: Gold
augments.desc: Gain a random <keywordMajor> Gold Augment</keywordMajor>.
augments.descZh: 获得1个随机<keywordMajor>黄金阶强化符文</keywordMajor>。

augments.name: Transmute: Prismatic
augments.desc: Gain a random <keywordMajor> Prismatic Augment</keywordMajor>.
augments.descZh: 获得1个随机<keywordMajor>棱彩阶强化符文</keywordMajor>。

augments.name: Transmute: Chaos
augments.desc: Gain <keywordMajor>2 random Augments</keywordMajor>.
augments.descZh: 获得<keywordMajor>2个随机强化符文</keywordMajor>。

augments.name: Divine Intervention
augments.desc: Every 35 seconds, <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> a protective star. Upon its landing, you and nearby allies become <keywordMajor>Invulnerable</keywordMajor> for a few seconds.
augments.descZh: 每35秒，<keywordMajor>自动施放</keywordMajor>一颗护体星星。在它着陆时，你和附近的友军们进入持续若干秒的<keywordMajor>免疫伤害</keywordMajor>状态。

augments.name: Leg Day
augments.desc: Gain <speed>50 Movement Speed</speed> and <speed>50% Slow Resist</speed>.
augments.descZh: 获得<speed>50移动速度</speed>和<speed>50%减速抗性</speed>。

augments.name: FireFox
augments.desc:
Autocast
Gain Movement Speed and conjure three flames that orbit you, targetting the closest visible enemy in range and dealing magic damage.
augments.descZh:
自动施放
获得移动速度并召唤3道烈焰环绕于你，瞄准距离内相距最近的那个可见英雄并造成魔法伤害。

augments.name: Clown College
augments.desc:
Gain Deceive Summoner Spell.
Gain Backstab Passive.

When you die, deal a large amount of true damage and Fear nearby enemies.
augments.descZh:
获得召唤师技能欺诈魔术。
获得背刺被动。

在你阵亡时，对附近的敌人们造成大量真实伤害和恐惧。

augments.name: Overflow
augments.desc:
Your Mana costs are doubled.

Your Ability Heals, Shields, and damage are increased based on your max Mana.
augments.descZh:
你的法力消耗翻倍。

你的技能的治疗效果、护盾效果和伤害获得提升，提升幅度基于你的最大法力值。

augments.name: Mighty Shield
augments.desc: Gain <font color = '#8347ff'>40 - 100 Adaptive Force</font> for 3 seconds when you gain a Shield (5 seconds Cooldown).
augments.descZh: 当你获得护盾时，获得<font color = '#8347ff'>40 - 100适应之力</font>，持续3秒。(5秒冷却时间)

augments.name: Swift and Safe
augments.desc: Gain a <shield>Shield</shield> after a Dash or Blink.
augments.descZh: 在冲刺或闪烁后，获得<shield>护盾值</shield>。

augments.name: Upgrade Zhonya's
augments.desc:
Reduce Zhonya's Hourglass Cooldown to 45 seconds. You can now move and gain Movement Speed when in Zhonya's Hourglass, Seeker's Armguard, or Wooglet's Witchcap stasis.

Gain 250 Gold.
augments.descZh:
【中娅沙漏】的冷却时间降低至45秒。你现在可以在【中娅沙漏】、【探索者的护臂】或【沃格勒特的巫师帽】凝滞状态持续期间移动并获得移动速度。

获得250金币。

augments.name: Upgrade Immolate
augments.desc: <attention>Hollow Radiance</attention> and <attention>Sunfire Aegis</attention> grant <gold>12 Gold</gold> per target affected with Immolate. Gain <gold>250 Gold</gold>.
augments.descZh: <attention>【璀璨回响】</attention>和<attention>【日炎圣盾】</attention>每当有目标受到【献祭】效果影响时，提供<gold>12 金币</gold> 。获得<gold>250金币</gold>。

augments.name: Upgrade Collector
augments.desc:
Executing enemies with The Collector's Passive increases its execute threshold and grants bonus Gold.
Gain 250 Gold.
augments.descZh:
在每次使用【收集者】的被动处决敌人时，会提升处决阈值，并且提供额外金币。
获得250金币。

augments.name: Get Excited!
augments.desc: Increase <speed>Movement Speed</speed> and <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for 4 seconds on takedown.
augments.descZh: 参与击杀后，在4秒内提升<speed>移动速度</speed>和<attackSpeed>攻击速度</attackSpeed>。

augments.name: Cruelty
augments.desc: On <status>Immobilizing</status> or <status>Grounding</status> a champion, summon a comet that lands after a delay, dealing <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies.
augments.descZh: <status>定身</status>或<status>缚地</status>一个英雄时，召唤一颗会在短暂延迟后着陆的彗星，对附近的敌人们造成<magicDamage>魔法伤害</magicDamage>。

augments.name: Protein Shake
augments.desc: Gain <healing>?% Heal and Shield Power</healing> based on bonus <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>.
augments.descZh: 获得<healing>?%治疗和护盾强度</healing>，基于额外<scaleArmor>护甲</scaleArmor>和<scaleMR>魔抗</scaleMR>。

augments.name: Glass Cannon
augments.desc: Reduce <scaleHealth>max Health by 30%</scaleHealth>. Deal an extra ? damage as <trueDamage>true damage</trueDamage>.
augments.descZh: 减少<scaleHealth>30%最大生命值</scaleHealth>。造成额外的?伤害作为<trueDamage>真实伤害</trueDamage>。

augments.name: Nightstalking
augments.desc: Takedowns against enemy champions within 3 seconds of damaging them grants you <speed>Movement Speed</speed> and renders you invisible.
augments.descZh: 在对敌人造成伤害的3秒内参与击杀该敌人会为你提供<speed>移动速度</speed>并使你进入隐身状态。

augments.name: Critical Rhythm
augments.desc:
Your basic Attack stacks Attack Speed on Critical Strikes.

Gain 25% Crit chance.
augments.descZh:
你的普攻在暴击时获得可叠加的攻击速度。

获得 25%暴击几率。

augments.name: Biggest Snowball Ever
augments.desc:
Gain 100 Ability Haste on Snowball.

Your snowball is BIG and will pass through minions. It Slows, Knocks Up champions, and deals additional damage.

If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.
augments.descZh:
你的雪球获得100技能急速。

你的雪球现在变得非常大，并且可以穿过小兵。它会减速， 击飞英雄，并造成额外伤害。

如果你没有雪球，则获得一个雪球。

augments.name: Empyrean Promise
augments.desc:
Gain 15% Heal and Shield power. Gain Empyrean Promise as a Summoner Spell.

Vigilance
Teleport to an ally and grant ? Shield for 3 seconds after landing.
augments.descZh:
获得15%治疗和护盾强度。获得至高天诺言作为一个召唤师技能。

警惕
传送至你的友军并在着陆时提供持续3秒的?护盾值。

augments.name: Ominous Pact
augments.desc: Gain <scaleAP>Ability Power</scaleAP>, <speed>Movement Speed</speed>, and <omnivamp>Omnivamp</omnivamp> based on <scaleHealth>missing Health</scaleHealth>, taking damage each time you cast.
augments.descZh: 基于<scaleHealth>已损失生命值</scaleHealth>，获得<scaleAP>法术强度</scaleAP>、<speed>移动速度</speed>和<omnivamp>全能吸血</omnivamp>，每次你施放技能时会对自身造成伤害。

augments.name: Escape Plan
augments.desc: Gain a massive <shield>decaying Shield</shield>, decaying <speed>Movement Speed</speed>, and a decaying shrink effect upon reaching <scaleHealth>35% Health</scaleHealth>.
augments.descZh: 在降至<scaleHealth>35%生命值</scaleHealth>时，获得巨量<shield>持续衰减的护盾</shield>、持续衰减的<speed>移动速度</speed>和持续衰减的缩小效果。

augments.name: Goldrend
augments.desc: Damaging a champion with Attacks or Abilities deals additional <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage>, and grants you <gold>Gold</gold> and <speed>Movement Speed</speed>.
augments.descZh: 用攻击或技能对一个英雄造成伤害时会造成额外<magicDamage>魔法伤害</magicDamage>，并为你提供<gold>金币</gold>和 <speed>移动速度</speed>。

augments.name: Upgrade Infinity Edge
augments.desc:
Gain 500 Gold.
Having Infinity Edge allows your Critical Strike Chance to grant random Critical Strike Damage each Attack.
augments.descZh:
获得500金币。
装备无尽之刃后，可使你的暴击几率在每次攻击都会提供随机的暴击伤害。

augments.name: King Me
augments.desc: The first time you take the enemy transport <attention>with a Legendary Item</attention> you become <font color = '#d158f9'>Kinged</font>, upgrading your item and gaining a random Prismatic Augment.
augments.descZh: 当你第一次<attention>携带一件传说级装备</attention>并乘坐敌人的传送门时，你会<font color = '#d158f9'>加冕为王</font>，升级你的装备并获得一个随机棱彩阶强化符文。

augments.name: Laser Heal
augments.desc: Cast a laser for 2.5 seconds that <scaleHealth>heals allies</scaleHealth>, and <status>Slows</status> and deals <scaleAP>magic damage</scaleAP> to enemies.
augments.descZh: 施放一个持续2.5秒的治疗激光，<scaleHealth>治疗友军</scaleHealth>，使敌人<status>减速</status>并对其造成<scaleAP>魔法伤害</scaleAP>。

augments.name: Snowball Roulette
augments.desc:
Gain 100 Ability Haste on Snowball. Hitting an enemy casts a random beneficial Summoner Spell on you and a harmful one on them. Following up recast the beneficial one on yourself.

If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.
augments.descZh:
雪球获得100技能急速。命中敌人时，随机对你自身施放一个增益型的召唤师技能并对你的目标施放一个减益型的召唤师技能。接第二段时会为你再次施放该增益型召唤师技能。

如果你没有雪球，则获得一个雪球。

augments.name: Sneakerhead
augments.desc:
Immediate: Gain a random pair of upgraded boots.

Requirement: Complete its quest to swap for another.

Reward: Jarvan I's Boot
augments.descZh:
即刻：随机获得一双升级后的靴子。

需求：完成其任务，以更换为另一双。

奖励：嘉文一世之靴

augments.name: Final Form
augments.desc: After casting your <attention>Ultimate</attention>, gain a <shield>max Health Shield</shield>, <lifeSteal>Omnivamp</lifeSteal> and <speed>Movement Speed</speed> for 10 seconds.
augments.descZh: 在施放你的<attention>终极技能</attention>时，获得持续10秒的<shield>最大生命值护盾</shield>、<lifeSteal>全能吸血</lifeSteal>和<speed>移动速度</speed>。

augments.name: Spiritual Purification
augments.desc: On takedown, creates an explosion that <status>slows</status> other nearby enemies by 60%, and deals damage based on their <scaleHealth>current Health</scaleHealth>.
augments.descZh: 参与击杀时，产生一次爆炸，对附近其它敌人们造成60%<status>减速</status>，并且造成基于他们<scaleHealth>当前生命值</scaleHealth>的伤害。

augments.name: Poltergeist
augments.desc:
Gain Poltergeist as a Summoner Spell.

Poltergeist casts both Barrier and Ghost.
augments.descZh:
获得【吵闹鬼】作为一个召唤师技能。

吵闹鬼会同时施放召唤师技能【屏障】和【幽灵疾步】。

augments.name: Flash 2
augments.desc: Gain a second Flash Summoner Spell and 70 Summoner Haste.
augments.descZh: 获得第二个【闪现】召唤师技能和70召唤师技能急速。

augments.name: Ultimate Awakening
augments.desc:
Gain 30 Ultimate Ability Haste.
After using your Ultimate, refresh your basic abilities and gain 300 basic ability haste for 15s. (20s Cooldown)
augments.descZh:
获得30终极技能急速。
在施放你的终极技能后，刷新你的所有基础技能并获得持续15秒的300基础技能急速。(20秒冷却时间)

augments.name: Tank Engine
augments.desc: On takedown, gain a stack that increases your size and <scaleHealth>max Health</scaleHealth>. Lose stacks on death.
augments.descZh: 参与击杀时，获得一个层数，使你的体型增大并提升<scaleHealth>最大生命值</scaleHealth>。阵亡时损失层数。

augments.name: Critical Missile
augments.desc:
When you Critically Strike, fire missiles dealing magic damage.

Gain 25% Crit chance.
augments.descZh:
当你暴击时，发射飞弹造成魔法伤害。

获得 25%暴击几率。

augments.name: Pinball
augments.desc:
Your Snowball gains Ability Haste and deals extra True Damage.

When the Snowball bounces off walls, it increases in size and damage and has a reduced Cooldown.
augments.descZh:
你的雪球获得技能急速并且造成额外的真实伤害。

当雪球从墙体上反弹时，它的体型和伤害获得提升，并缩短它的冷却时间。

augments.name: Icathia's Fall
augments.desc:
Immediately: Gain a Bami's Cinder.

QUEST: Possess Sunfire Aegis and Hollow Radiance.

REWARD: These Items combine into Void Immolation.
augments.descZh:
即刻：获得1个【斑比的熔渣】。

任务：持有日炎圣盾和璀璨回响。

奖励：将这些装备合成为虚空献祭。

augments.name: I'm a Baby Kitty Where is Mama
augments.desc:
Standing next to an ally marks them as your mama.
Gain Movement Speed when moving towards Mama. Gain Movement Speed and heal and Shield Power when close to your mama.
augments.descZh:
站在一个友军的附近并将其标记为你的妈妈。
当朝着妈妈移动时，获得移动速度。当靠近你的妈妈时，获得移动速度、治疗和护盾强度。

augments.name: Shrink Engine
augments.desc:
Takedowns makes you smaller and grant Ability Haste and Movement Speed.

Lose 65% stacks on death.
augments.descZh:
参与击杀后会让你变小并且获得技能急速和移动速度。

阵亡时损失65%层数。

augments.name: Soul Eater
augments.desc:
Immobilizing an enemy champion grants 30 max Health.

If taken as your second Augment, starts with 300 Health.
augments.descZh:
定身一个敌方英雄时会提供30最大生命值。

如果是你的第二个强化符文，会自带300生命值。

augments.name: Upgrade Sword of Blossoming Dawn
augments.desc:
Gain 100% Attack Speed.

Increase Sword of Blossoming Dawn's healing to 250% when you attack enemy champions.
augments.descZh:
获得100%攻击速度。

你对英雄的攻击会使来自【花晓之剑】的治疗效果提升250%。

augments.name: Donation
augments.desc: Get <font color="#ffd138">1750</font> Gold. No questions asked.
augments.descZh: 获得<font color="#ffd138">1750</font>金币。无需多问。

augments.name: Spin Me Right Round
augments.desc:
Replace a Summoner Spell with Heroic Swing.

Heroic Swing fires a grappling hook, sticking into terrain, after which you can Recast to swing around it. While swinging, automatically Attack the nearest enemy. Colliding with an enemy champion or Recasting ends the swing.
augments.descZh:
将一个召唤师技能替换为骄行荡寇。

骄行荡寇发射一根钩爪，吸附在地形上，在此之后，你可以再次施放来绕着它摆荡。在摆荡状态下，自动攻击相距最近的那个敌人。在与一个敌方英雄碰撞或再次施放时结束摆荡。

augments.name: Infinite Recursion
augments.desc: Gain 60 Ability Haste, plus 3 Ability Haste per takedown.
augments.descZh: 获得60技能急速，外加每次参与击杀3技能急速。

augments.name: Hand of Baron
augments.desc: Gain <scaleAP>25% Adaptive Force</scaleAP>. Nearby allied minions are greatly empowered.
augments.descZh: 获得<scaleAP>25%适应之力</scaleAP>。附近友方小兵都获得极大增强。

augments.name: Phenomenal Evil
augments.desc:
Permanently gain 1 Ability Power when you damage enemy champions with Abilities.

If taken as your second Augment, starts with 40 Ability Power.
augments.descZh:
在你用技能对敌人造成伤害时永久获得1法术强度。

如果是作为你的第二个强化符文，则自带40法术强度。

augments.name: Holy Snowball
augments.desc:
Gain 100 Ability Haste on Snowball.

You are briefly Invulnerable when you dash with Snowball.

If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.
augments.descZh:
雪球获得100技能急速。

你在用【雪球】冲刺后短暂免疫伤害。

如果你没有雪球，获得一个雪球。

augments.name: Final City Transit
augments.desc: When you die, launch a train towards your killer, dealing <physicalDamage>? physical damage</physicalDamage> to enemies it hits. The train does not stop.
augments.descZh: 在你阵亡时，朝击杀你的敌人发动一辆列车，对它命中的每个敌人造成<physicalDamage>?物理伤害</physicalDamage>。这个列车不会停下。

augments.name: Growth Spurt
augments.desc:
Gain Growth Spurt as a Summoner Spell.

Growth Spurt suddenly increases your size, Knocking Up nearby enemies and granting max Health.
augments.descZh:
获得生机迸发作为一个召唤师技能。

生机迸发会猛然提升你的体型，击飞附近的敌人们并提供最大生命值。

augments.name: Stats on Stats on Stats!
augments.desc:
Gain 4 Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of Gold and Prismatic Anvils!

On your next Augment selection, gain one additional reroll per slot.
augments.descZh:
获得4个【属性锻造器】，有更高几率出现黄金阶和棱彩阶锻造器！

在你的下一次强化符文选取时，每个栏位获得一次额外的刷新。

augments.name: Stats on Stats!
augments.desc: Gain 3 Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of Gold and Prismatic Anvils!
augments.descZh: 获得3个【属性锻造器】，有更高几率出现黄金阶和棱彩阶锻造器！

augments.name: Stats!
augments.desc: Gain 2 Stat Anvils!
augments.descZh: 获得2个【属性锻造器】！

augments.name: Grandma's Chili Oil
augments.desc:
Basic attacks and ability hits against enemies inflicts them with a Burn that drops a pool of Chili Oil nearby. Chili Oil restores Health and Burns enemies.

Chili Oil effects become stronger for each Burn you apply.
augments.descZh:
普攻和技能在命中敌人时会对其施加一个灼烧，这个效果会在附近掉落一滩辣椒油。辣椒油会回复生命值并灼烧敌人们。

你施加的每个灼烧都会使辣椒油效果变得更强。

augments.name: Poro Blaster
augments.desc: You gather Poros over time. Damaging an enemy fires all Poros at them, each dealing <trueDamage>max Health true damage</trueDamage>. If you have 5 Poros, they will <status>Knock Back</status> once.
augments.descZh: 你周期性地召集魄罗。伤害一个敌人时会对其发射所有魄罗，每个魄罗造成目标<trueDamage>最大生命值真实伤害</trueDamage>。如果你有5个魄罗，那么它们会进行一次<status>击退</status>。

augments.name: Stuck In Here With Me
augments.desc:
Using your Ultimate Taunts nearby enemies and grants you damage reduction.

Gain 30 Ultimate Ability Haste.
augments.descZh:
使用你的终极技能时会嘲讽附近的敌人们并提供给你伤害减免。

获得30终极技能急速。

augments.name: Droppybara
augments.desc:
Gain Droppybara as a Summoner Spell.

After a delay, call down a capybara that deals 25% max Health true damage.
augments.descZh:
获得卡皮巴拉空投作为一个召唤师技能。

在一阵延迟后，召唤一个卡皮巴拉落下，造成25%最大生命值的真实伤害。

augments.name: Twin Fire
augments.desc:
On ability damage, fire 1 plus ? missiles that deal ? magic damage each.

Gain 25% Critical Strike Chance.
augments.descZh:
造成技能伤害时，发射1+?个飞弹，每个造成?魔法伤害。

此外，获得25%暴击几率。

augments.name: Hextech Soul
augments.desc: Periodically your next damaging Ability or Attack triggers a lightning blast, chaining through enemies to deal damage and <status>Slow</status>.
augments.descZh: 周期性地使你的下一个伤害型技能或攻击触发一道闪电爆裂，连锁穿过敌人以造成伤害和<status>减速</status>。

augments.name: Sonata
augments.desc:
Every 10 seconds, automatically cast the Aria of Perseverence and Song of Celerity in an alternating melody.

Aria of Perseverence heals nearby allies and grants a temporary shielding aura.

Song of Celerity grants a temporary aura that provides bonus Movement Speed.
augments.descZh:
每10秒，以一个不断交替的旋律来自动施放坚毅咏叹调和迅捷奏鸣曲。

坚毅咏叹调治疗附近友军并提供一个临时的护盾光环。

迅捷奏鸣曲提供一个临时光环来提供额外移动速度。

augments.name: Prom Queen
augments.desc: Every 35 seconds, <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> a sparkly tiara descends upon you. When it lands, gain Rakan's Ultimate, charming enemies you touch.
augments.descZh: 每35秒，<keywordMajor>自动施放</keywordMajor>一道闪亮宝冠降临在你头上。当它着陆时，获得洛的终极技能，魅惑你碰到的敌人们。

augments.desc: Your <passive>Missing Pings</passive> will launch a missile at the pinged location that <magicdamage>damages</magicdamage> enemies and <heal>heals</heal> allies.
augments.descZh: 你的<passive>敌人消失信号</passive>将发射一个飞弹至被信号标记的位置，这个飞弹会<magicdamage>伤害</magicdamage>敌人并<heal>治疗</heal>友军。

augments.name: Upgrade Sheen
augments.desc: Your <passive>Spellblade</passive> effects deal <physical>additional damage</physical> and <heal>heal</heal> you for a percent of the target's health. Additionally, gain <gold>250 Gold</gold>.
augments.descZh: 你的<passive>咒刃</passive>效果造成<physical>额外伤害</physical>并<heal>治疗</heal>你自身，治疗量相当于目标生命值的一定百分比。此外，获得<gold>250金币</gold>。

augments.name: Bounce of the Poro King
augments.desc:
Gain Bounce of the Poro King!

Bounce of the Poro King: Transform into the Poro King, bouncing repeatedly, dealing physical damage and Knocking Back nearby enemies.
augments.descZh:
获得魄罗之王的弹跳！

魄罗之王的弹跳：变身为【魄罗之王】并反复弹跳，造成物理伤害并击退 附近的敌人们。

augments.name: Empowered By The Faithful
augments.desc:
Healing or Shielding allies blesses them, causing their damage to fill you with devotion.

When you have enough devotion, unleash a shockwave dealing magic damage and executes low health enemies.
augments.descZh:
为友军提供治疗或护盾会赐福他们，使其伤害填充你的虔诚。

当你拥有足够的虔诚时，释放一道冲击波来造成魔法伤害并处决低生命值的敌人们。

augments.name: Triggered Inferno
augments.desc: Gain <spellName>Daredevil Impulse</spellName>. When you reach S <keywordMajor>Style</keywordMajor>, automatically use <spellName>Inferno Trigger</spellName>.
augments.descZh: 获得<spellName>悍勇本色</spellName>。在你达到S<keywordMajor>评价等级</keywordMajor>时，自动使用<spellName>炼狱扳机</spellName>。

augments.name: Dropkick
augments.desc: Your Attacks and Abilities execute low Health enemy champions, Knocking Back and causing an explosion while healing you.
augments.descZh: 你的攻击和技能会处决低生命值的敌方英雄，从而击退并引发一次爆炸，同时治疗你自身。

augments.name: Zealot
augments.desc: Gain <attention>? Critical Strike Chance</attention> and <attackSpeed>? Attack Speed</attackSpeed>.
augments.descZh: 获得<attention>?暴击几率</attention>和<attackSpeed>?攻击速度</attackSpeed>（随法术强度变化）。

augments.name: Double Tap
augments.desc:
Your Critical Strikes apply On-Hit effects an additional time.

Gain 25% Crit chance.
augments.descZh:
你的暴击施加一次额外的攻击特效。

获得 25%暴击几率。

augments.name: Juiced
augments.desc: <OnHit> On-Hit</OnHit> deal <magicDamage>? magic damage</magicDamage>, this damage can <crit>Critically Strike</crit>.
augments.descZh: <OnHit>攻击特效</OnHit>造成<magicDamage>?魔法伤害</magicDamage>，这个伤害可以<crit>暴击</crit>。

augments.name: Purist - Caster
augments.desc: Gain percent cooldown reduction and convert all of your <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> into Ability Haste.
augments.descZh: 获得百分比冷却缩减并将你的所有<attackSpeed>攻击速度</attackSpeed>转化为技能急速。

augments.name: Kill Secured
augments.desc: Gain increased <speed>Movement Speed</speed> towards enemies at low Health.
augments.descZh: 在朝着低生命值的敌人时，获得额外<speed>移动速度</speed>。

augments.name: DropBear
augments.desc: On death, a giant Tibbers with all your augments falls from the sky and damages nearby enemies.
augments.descZh: 阵亡时，一个具有你所有强化符文的巨大提伯斯从天而降并伤害附近的敌人们。

augments.name: Shark Bait
augments.desc: A few seconds after death, a shark chomps all nearby enemies. You can move after death to aim the shark attack.
augments.descZh: 在阵亡之后的若干秒，一头鲨鱼会啃噬所有附近的敌人们。你可以在阵亡后进行移动，以给鲨鱼攻击进行定位。

augments.name: Shark Tempest
augments.desc: Sharks circle your Snowball, <status>slowing</status> and damaging nearby enemies. When your Snowball hits a Champion, they become trapped in a shark storm!
augments.descZh: 鲨鱼们环绕着你的【雪球】，对附近的敌人们造成伤害和<status>减速</status>。当你的【雪球】命中一个英雄时，其会陷入一阵鲨鱼风暴之中！

augments.name: Hide on Bush
augments.desc: After entering <keyword>Brush</keyword>, deal <attention>20%</attention> more damage for <attention>2</attention> seconds. Remain in the <keyword>Brush</keyword> to refresh the effect.
augments.descZh: 在进入<keyword>草丛</keyword>后，多造成<attention>20%</attention>伤害，持续<attention>2</attention>秒。留在<keyword>草丛</keyword>中会刷新这个效果。

augments.name: Nature is Healing
augments.desc: Entering <keyword>Brush</keyword> regenerates <healing>a large amount of Health</healing>.
augments.descZh: 进入<keyword>草丛</keyword>时回复<healing>大量生命值</healing>。

augments.name: Tripleshot
augments.desc: Your <font color='#F0C200'>?</font> targets 2 additional enemies in front of you.
augments.descZh: 你的【<font color='#F0C200'>?</font>】技能会瞄准你前方2个额外的敌人。

augments.name: Multishot

augments.descZh:
任务：用【?】技能命中敌方英雄?次。

augments.descZh: 施放你的【<font color='#F0C200'>?</font>】技能时会朝你的鼠标位置派出一个复制体并再次施放该技能。

augments.name: Quickstep
augments.desc: When you use <font color='#F0C200'>?</font>, dash towards your cursor.
augments.descZh: 当你使用【<font color='#F0C200'>?</font>】技能时，朝你的鼠标指针进行冲刺。

augments.name: Terror
augments.desc: Whenever you cast <font color='#F0C200'>?</font>, <status>Fear</status> enemies around you.
augments.descZh: 每当你施放【<font color='#F0C200'>?</font>】技能时，<status>恐惧</status>你周围的敌人们.

augments.name: Spell Split
augments.desc: Your <font color='#F0C200'>?</font> missile splits into two on hit, at max Range, or when <recast>Recast</recast>.
augments.descZh: 在命中时、最大距离时或<recast>再次施放</recast>时，你的【<font color='#F0C200'>?</font>】技能的飞弹会分裂为两部分。

augments.name: Siphon
augments.desc: Damaging enemy champions with <font color='#F0C200'>?</font> <healing>heals</healing> you.
augments.descZh: 用【<font color='#F0C200'>?</font>】技能伤害敌方英雄时会<healing>治疗</healing>你。

augments.name: Stay Resolute
augments.desc: When <font color='#F0C200'>?</font> damages enemy champions, gain ? <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resistance</scaleMR>.
augments.descZh: 当【<font color='#F0C200'>?</font>】技能对敌方英雄造成伤害时，获得?<scaleArmor>护甲</scaleArmor>和<scaleMR>魔法抗性</scaleMR>。

augments.name: Ravenous Bind
augments.desc: <status>Immobilizing</status> or <status>Grounding</status> enemy champions with <font color='#F0C200'>?</font> deals extra <magicDamage>damage</magicDamage> and <healing>heals you</healing>.
augments.descZh: 用你的【<font color='#F0C200'>?</font>】技能<status>定身</status>或<status>缚地</status>敌方英雄时造成额外<magicDamage>伤害</magicDamage>并<healing>对你进行治疗</healing>。

augments.name: Chain Reaction
augments.desc: If a target <status>Knocked Back</status> by <font color='#F0C200'>?</font> hits another champion, they are <status>Knocked Up</status> and dealt <magicDamage>damage</magicDamage>. When colliding with terrain, the <status>Knock Up</status> duration is extended and they are dealt <magicDamage>bonus damage</magicDamage>.
augments.descZh: 如果一个被【<font color='#F0C200'>?</font>】技能<status>击退</status>的目标命中了另一个英雄，则二者都会被<status>击飞</status>并受到<magicDamage>伤害</magicDamage>。在与地形产生碰撞时，该<status>击飞</status>时长会延长并且他们会受到<magicDamage>额外伤害</magicDamage>。

augments.name: Snowblast
augments.desc: Recasting <spellName>Snowball</spellName> deals increased damage, <status>Knocks Up</status> the target, and <status>Knocks Back</status> nearby enemies.
augments.descZh: 再次施放<spellName>雪球</spellName>会造成提升<magicDamage>伤害</magicDamage>、<status>击飞</status>该目标、并<status>击退</status>附近的敌人们。

augments.name: Our Healing
augments.desc: Whenever someone heals around you, you <healing>heal 15%</healing> of their own healing. Doubled from Enemy healing.
augments.descZh: 每当你周围的某人进行治疗时，你获得相当于<healing>其15%治疗效果的治疗效果</healing>。从敌方治疗中获得双倍。

augments.name: Tooth Fairy
augments.desc: Bursting enemies drops <keyword>Teeth</keyword>. Picking up <keyword>Teeth</keyword> grants you permanent <scaleLethality>Lethality</scaleLethality> and <magicPen>Magic Penetration</magicPen>.
augments.descZh: 爆裂敌人会掉落<keyword>牙齿</keyword>。拾取<keyword>牙齿</keyword>会提供给你永久的<scaleLethality>穿甲</scaleLethality>和<magicPen>法术穿透</magicPen>。

augments.name: Archmage
augments.desc: Casting a spell refunds another random spell's cost by 30% of the original spell's Cooldown.
augments.descZh: 施放一个技能会返还另一个随机技能的花费，数额相当于30%原技能冷却时间。

augments.name: Snowday
augments.desc: Gain 100 Ability Haste on your Snowball. It deals additional magic damage when hitting an enemy. If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.
augments.descZh: 你的【雪球】获得100技能急速。在命中一名敌人时造成额外魔法伤害。如果你没有【雪球】，则获得一个【雪球】。

augments.name: Endless Decimation
augments.desc: While in combat, <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> a circular axe that deals <physicalDamage>physical damage</physicalDamage>. Enemies on the outer edge take additional damage and <healing>heal</healing> you.
augments.descZh: 在战斗状态下，<keywordMajor>自动施放</keywordMajor>一次环形斧头挥舞从而造成<physicalDamage>物理伤害</physicalDamage>。被斧刃命中的敌人们受到额外伤害并<healing>治疗</healing>你。

augments.name: Lil' Extra Help
augments.desc: Gain ? Attack Range and ? <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> during your <font color='#F0C200'>?</font> duration.
augments.descZh: 在你的【<font color='#F0C200'>?</font>】技能持续期间获得?攻击距离和?<attackSpeed>攻击速度</attackSpeed>。

augments.name: En Passant
augments.desc: Periodically identify <keywordMajor>Vitals</keywordMajor> on enemy champions. Hitting them with Attacks or Abilities deals <trueDamage>max Health true damage</trueDamage>, <healing>restores Health</healing>, and grants <speed>Movement Speed</speed>. These effects can stack.
augments.descZh: 周期性地识别出敌方英雄身上的<keywordMajor>破绽</keywordMajor>。用攻击或技能命中破绽时，会造成<trueDamage>最大生命值真实伤害</trueDamage>、<healing>回复生命值</healing>并提供<speed>移动速度</speed>。这些效果可以叠加。

augments.name: Rite of Ascension
augments.desc: On takedown, enemy champions leave behind their Essence. Attacking the Essence grants <speed>movement speed</speed> and resets basic ability cooldowns.
augments.descZh: 参与击杀敌方英雄后会留下其精华。攻击该精华会提供<speed>移动速度</speed>并重置基础技能冷却时间。

augments.name: Pursuit of Haste
augments.desc:
QUEST: Hit enemy champions with ? ? times.

REWARD: Gain Ability Haste on ? per Quest Level up to 160.
augments.descZh:
任务：用【?】技能命中敌方英雄?次

奖励：【?】技能获得技能急速，基于任务等级，至多至160。

augments.name: Pressure Cooker
augments.desc:
Every second, apply a stacking Burn to nearby enemy champions, scaling with your max Health.

QUEST: Deal Burn damage to enemy Champions.

REWARD: Size and damage increase per Quest Level.
augments.descZh:
每一秒，对附近的敌方英雄们施加一层可叠加的灼烧，这个效果受益于你的最大生命值。

任务：对敌方英雄造成灼烧伤害。

奖励：每任务等级都会提升体型和伤害。

augments.name: From Downtown
augments.desc:
QUEST: Snipe ? enemy champions with abilities

REWARD: Send a meteor at Sniped enemy champions, dealing Magic damage in an area around them
augments.descZh:
任务：用技能狙击?个敌方英雄

奖励：一颗流星会飞向被狙击的敌方英雄，在其周围的一个区域内造成魔法伤害

augments.name: Spirit Bomb
augments.desc: <healing>Healing</healing> and <shield>Shielding</shield> allied champions builds up a Spirit Bomb. At max stacks, toss the bomb onto <scaleHealth>lowest Health ally</scaleHealth> to <healing>heal</healing> and <shield>shield</shield> them and nearby allies.
augments.descZh: 为友方英雄提供<healing>治疗</healing>和<shield>护盾</shield>时会为你积攒一颗【灵魄炸弹】。在满层时，投掷该炸弹至<scaleHealth>生命值最低的那个友军</scaleHealth>，从而对其和附近友军们提供<healing>治疗</healing>和<shield>护盾</shield>。

augments.name: Hellbent
augments.desc: Damaging enemy champions with Attacks or Abilities grants stacks. At max stacks, you <attention>revive empowered</attention> upon death.
augments.descZh: 用攻击或技能伤害敌方英雄时会提供层数。在满层时，你会在阵亡时进行<attention>复活强化</attention>。

augments.name: BONK!
augments.desc: Attacks and Abilities empowered by <font color='#F0C200'>?</font> deal additional damage to the target and nearby enemies.
augments.descZh: 被【<font color='#F0C200'>?</font>】技能强化的攻击或技能会对目标和附近的敌人们造成额外伤害。

augments.name: Squishy Slappy Grab
augments.desc: Occasionally send out squishy, slappy hands towards all nearby enemy champions, tethering them. Your next attack will pull in all tethered enemies.
augments.descZh: 偶尔对所有附近的敌方英雄放出软弹啪叽的手，然后用灵链系住。你的下次攻击将拉拽所有被系住的敌人。

augments.name: Pursuit of Power

任务：用【?】技能命中敌人?次。

augments.name: Overextender
augments.desc: Recall to enter your Cannon Launcher. It has significantly increased range, travel speed, and damage.
augments.descZh: 回城并进入到你的加农炮发射器。它的距离、飞行速度和伤害已经得到显著提升。

augments.name: Overloaded
augments.desc: Using another Ability resets the cooldown of <font color='#F0C200'>?</font>.
augments.descZh: 使用另一个技能会重置【<font color='#F0C200'>?</font>】技能的冷却时间。

augments.name: It's Go Time
augments.desc: Activating <font color='#F0C200'>?</font> grants you <speed>Movement Speed</speed> for its duration.

augments.name: Forged By The Master

augments.descZh: 使你的装备和强化符文伤害提升<attention>45%</attention>。

augments.descZh: 英雄身上的灼烧和持续伤害会生成<gold>金币</gold>。

augments.name: Terrain'd

augments.name: Mercy's Strike
augments.desc: After healing or shielding your ally with <font color='#F0C200'>?</font>, your next basic attack gains <attention>attack range</attention>, <speed>attack speed</speed> and deals bonus <magicDamage>max Health magic damage</magicDamage>.
augments.descZh: 在使用【<font color='#F0C200'>?</font>】技能为你的友军提供治疗或护盾之后，你的下一次普攻获得<attention>攻击距离</attention>、<speed>攻击速度</speed>并造成额外<magicDamage>最大生命值魔法伤害</magicDamage>。
